# Hey, I'm Salman Kootoobally 👋

### Salesforce Consultant @ Nexavenu · Full-Stack Developer · Founder @ Noralux Solutions Ltd 🇲🇺

I'm a Salesforce consultant and full-stack software engineer from Mauritius. I take products from first idea through design, build, deployment and maintenance. I've shipped booking systems, travel platforms, logistics software, e-commerce stores, CRM solutions and AI-powered apps. I've been a founding engineer at early-stage teams, and I now run my own company, **Noralux Solutions Ltd**.

🎓 BSc (Hons) Software Engineering, University of Mauritius: **First Class Honours, GPA 4.00**, Dean's Merit List
